Anchor.description:
Provenance anchor: binds knowledge to source, tests, docs or reviewed changes.

`source`/`test` anchors need `repo` and `path`, `change` anchors need `change` or
`commit`, `doc` anchors need `path`. A test anchor does not prove that the test runs.

AnchorStamp.description: Hash of an exact, inclusive line span in a Git blob at an immutable host commit.

`rules`, `settings`, `overrides` is non-empty).

Scope.description:
Mandatory applicability. AND across dimensions, OR within a dimension.

`product = true` XOR at least one non-empty dimension (an accidental empty scope is an
error). Registry existence and satisfiability are checked by `validate`.

change_types.description: Change categories. An unknown task category must never exclude an obligation.

product.description: Product-wide applicability. When true, all other dimensions must be empty.

Selectors.description: Relevance signals. Never exclude an applicable obligation.

Setting.description:
A named, typed policy setting that may be overridable.

`value` must have the declared `type`; `stricter` is required iff
`override = "stricter"` and must fit the type (integer: lower/higher, boolean:
true/false, string-set: superset/subset; strings have no stricter direction);
`override_owners` is only meaningful for overridable settings.

name.description: Setting name, unique within the policy.

override_owners.description: Owner ids allowed to override (empty: any owner).

SettingValue.description: A setting value. TOML integers, booleans, strings and string arrays.

conditions.description: Conditions under which the statement applies (all must hold).

id.description: Local id, unique within the record.

Stricter.description: Direction in which a setting value becomes stricter.

source.description: A record id, reviewed change, repository path or authoritative URL.

VerifyProbe.description: Declarative checks, never shell commands. Regexes use the bounded Rust regex engine.
